title: af-onset-within-patient: a within-patient test of AF onset predictors, including the published AF-Mamba weights
description: Analysis code for a study testing whether atrial fibrillation (AF) onset predictors trained against healthy controls detect an approaching episode or an AF patient. A plain-PyTorch port of the Mamba layer runs the published AF-Mamba weights on CPU (reproducing the reported AUC 0.974) and scores sinus hours far from any AF episode in the same patients on IRIDIA-AF (out of fold) and SHDB-AF. Retrained HRV models and a 1D CNN compare between-database and within-patient designs on PhysioNet data. No data and no third-party model code are included.
